build_symmetric_solids_builder: build a SymmetricSolids dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('symmetric_solids')
create_symmetric_solids_dataset: create a SymmetricSolids dataset with tfds.load('symmetric_solids') for train and test splits
test_symmetric_solids: test the SymmetricSolids dataset builder with tfds.testing.test_main()
